title: Dataset Contract Gate
tagline: Quarantine invalid records and fail ingestion on explicit dataset rules.
summary: Define a small versioned data contract, check field types and bounds, find every row in duplicate groups, and export accepted records separately from quarantine. A CLI exit code gates ingestion while a source-line report explains failures.

languageWhy.Python: Standard dictionaries, numeric checks and JSONL IO make cross-row validation easy to inspect.

prerequisites: Python 3.12+; dictionaries, lists and command-line IO
skills: Find all rows in a duplicate group
Export partitions and enforce the dataset gate

stages.title: Validate an explicit quality contract
stages.summary: Require version=1 and a nonempty fields object.

stages.title: Find all rows in a duplicate group
stages.summary: For each unique column, index valid typed values to one-based input row numbers.
concepts: find all rows in a duplicate group

stages.title: Export partitions and enforce the dataset gate
stages.summary: Return schema_version=1, passed, counts, dataset_issues, duplicates, accepted and quarantine.
concepts: export partitions and enforce the dataset gate
